title: The Intent Centre home
caption: The organiser starts from the Intent Centre, which lists every session and offers Prepare a session.

title: Choose people and name rule
caption: The organiser sets how many people join, how the time is shared and how names show on notes.

title: Review and save the draft
caption: Before anything starts the organiser checks every choice, including the names rule and the named approver, and saves a draft.

title: Seats and prepared choices
caption: Once the room is started the four seats are filled and the prepared choices, such as each person chooses names, become read-only.

title: A guest waits in the lobby
caption: A guest who joined by link, with no account, sees the same lobby as everyone else and waits for the briefing.

title: The briefing with its video
caption: Everyone reads the room rules and watches the short video before the private rooms open.

title: Private room with North
caption: Each person talks privately with North, the industry expert, and keeps what matters as a note draft.

title: Mark what kind of note
caption: Each note is marked as an intent, a pain point, a future signal or a lever, with its details and a priority.

title: Start from an industry problem
caption: A person can start a note from a common industry problem, reword it in their own words and add it.

title: Notes are in
caption: After submitting, the person is told their notes are in and the board opens when the rooms close.

title: North groups the notes
caption: When the rooms close North suggests groups and says why, and leaves unsure notes on their own.

title: The organiser adjusts the groups
caption: The organiser renames, merges and moves notes by hand so every note sits in a group the room agrees with.

title: Vote and tick together
caption: Everyone votes on each problem and the organiser ticks the ones that go into the charter.

title: Confirm the So that lines
caption: North drafts a So that line for each problem and the organiser checks it before anyone signs.

title: The signed charter
caption: Both signers have signed, the charter is read-only and can be downloaded as a document or as text.

title: Measures to baseline
caption: Module 2 starts from the signed charter and offers industry measures as clearly labelled suggestions to confirm.

title: Lens drafts the definitions
caption: Lens drafts a definition for each measure, shows which documents it read, and marks each as a guess until a person confirms.

title: Owners and who may see it
caption: Each measure gets a business, data and process owner, and a personal-data setting that controls who may see it.

title: Links to send to owners
caption: Nira prepares an answer link and a short email for each owner; nothing is sent for the organiser.

title: An owner answers by link
caption: An owner with no sign-in answers a short questionnaire in plain words and marks how sure they are.

title: Who has answered
caption: The organiser sees which owners have answered, which are waiting and which will answer in a meeting.

title: Answering in a meeting
caption: The organiser can fill in the same questionnaire for an owner in a meeting, and the answer is marked as given in a meeting.

title: The as-is process map
caption: Lens draws how each measure is produced today from what the owners said, with unconfirmed steps shown dashed.

title: The data catalogue
caption: The catalogue lists each data source, its owner, how often it arrives and whether it holds personal data, filled from the owners' answers.

title: Ready for sign-off
caption: A checklist shows every measure has owners, a source and confirmed parts before the baseline can be signed.

title: Baseline signed and handed on
caption: The sponsor and then the head of data have signed, the baseline is read-only and handed on to module 3.
